notes: Settings-revamp release: the sticky save bar gains a CANCEL that discards every pending edit and repaints the form from the server's own truth, with light client-side shape checks (URL format, port range) that name the field instantly while the server stays the authority. The Overview tail now carries a readable mood next to its words — one hue per state and a small wag while working, with the words staying the accessible truth and motion honoring reduced-motion preferences. Mass-market onboarding: three one-click model presets (OpenAI-compatible / Ollama / LM Studio) fill the kernel endpoint from the server's loopback detection and stay behind the normal SAVE, the first-run welcome points at them, and the Overview self-metered panel now shows month-to-date requests and cost read from the same local usage meter — an unconfigured price table keeps the honest dash, never a zero. Fixes: the no-price note on the self panel was dead code, a dozen dev probes still targeted the pre-port-change default, and the public fact strip carried stale smoke/packs/desktop counts. Smoke grows a month-block leg to 439/439; locale packs reach 1247 keys per language; frontend UI E2E gains nine legs covering the cancel, validation, preset and tail-mood contracts.
